TELCO-6117 — Modernise the "Contact us" flow
Priority: Medium Component: Customer Experience

Description

The current "Contact us" flow is dated and results in poor NPS scores in post-interaction surveys. Modernise it to align with our new digital strategy and reduce time-to-resolution.

Acceptance Criteria

The new flow feels modern and responsive.
Wait times are reduced.
Accessibility is improved.
The design is consistent with our new brand.
Customers can seamlessly hand off to a human agent when needed.
Non-Functional

Scale must support peak load.
Personal information must be handled appropriately.

TELCO-6117 exploratory test design is complete.

Artefacts generated (Gherkin, JSON, and Markdown):
- `features/85b61bf0ad49428a873998e61dd721ed/docs/TELCO-6117-contact-us-modernisation.feature`
- `features/85b61bf0ad49428a873998e61dd721ed/docs/TELCO-6117-contact-us-modernisation.json`
- `features/85b61bf0ad49428a873998e61dd721ed/docs/TELCO-6117-contact-us-modernisation.md`

Coverage: 7 of 7 acceptance criteria.

Techniques used:
- Exploratory testing: modern/responsive UI and accessibility
- Comparative analysis: wait-time reduction
- Checklist review: brand alignment
- State-transition: human-agent handoff
- Performance characterisation: peak load
- Data-flow analysis: personal-information handling

All undefined targets, standards, policy controls, brand references, and browser/device scope remain marked TBD. The generated scenarios intentionally record evidence for later assessment rather than inventing pass/fail thresholds.
